name: Requesty
blurb: Unified LLM gateway with smart routing, caching and analytics across 400+ models. Requesty exposes a dedicated Nebius provider, routing requests to Nebius Token Factory open models through one OpenAI-compatible endpoint at pass-through pricing.

name: Dask Cloud Provider
blurb: Spins up distributed Dask clusters on cloud infrastructure straight from Python. Its NebiusCluster class provisions schedulers and workers on Nebius AI Cloud VMs, so data-science and ML workloads scale out across Nebius GPU/CPU instances.

name: Retool
blurb: Low-code platform for building internal apps and AI workflows. Retool ships a native Tavily Search integration, letting builders run general or news-specific web searches against the Tavily API directly inside Retool apps and workflows.

name: Pipedream
blurb: Workflow automation platform with thousands of app integrations and code-level control. Its Tavily app provides a Send Query action for real-time web search plus content extraction, usable in both no-code and code steps of any Pipedream workflow.

name: BuildShip
blurb: Low-code visual backend and workflow builder for AI apps and agents. BuildShip offers a prebuilt Tavily Search node that drops real-time, LLM-optimized web search and content retrieval into automation flows alongside hundreds of other app nodes.

name: Sim
blurb: Open-source workflow builder for deploying and orchestrating AI agents. Sim exposes Tavily as a first-class tool block with search, extract, crawl and map operations, giving agents real-time web access and content extraction inside visual flows.

name: Activepieces
blurb: Open-source, self-hostable workflow automation platform with a visual flow builder. Activepieces provides a Tavily MCP integration so AI agents and automation flows can call Tavily web search and extraction as a tool over the Model Context Protocol.
